text: Given organization_id, flexible_asset_type_id and traits with no archived/restricted, when create_flexible_asset is called, then the request sent to IT Glue and the tool's response are unchanged from before this ticket.
evidence: uv run pytest -q tests/test_flexible_assets.py::test_create_flexible_asset_happy_path -> 1 passed (also confirms AC4: body has no archived/restricted keys when omitted)

text: Given archived=true passed to create_flexible_asset, when it is called, then the POST body sent to IT Glue includes "archived": true, and the response reflects archived: true.

text: Given restricted=true passed to create_flexible_asset, when it is called, then the POST body sent to IT Glue includes "restricted": true, and the response reflects restricted: true.

text: Given archived and restricted are both omitted, when create_flexible_asset is called, then neither key appears in the request body sent to IT Glue.
evidence: covered by test_create_flexible_asset_happy_path: asserted POST body == exact dict with no archived/restricted keys -> 1 passed

text: Given a trait value containing HTML markup, when create_flexible_asset is called, then the value is forwarded to IT Glue unmodified (not escaped or stripped).
evidence: uv run pytest -q tests/test_flexible_assets.py::test_create_flexible_asset_forwards_html_trait_value_unmodified -> 1 passed; HTML trait value round-trips unescaped in request body and response

text: Given a real IT Glue tenant, when an agent creates a flexible asset with archived=true and restricted=true, reads it back, and compares against the IT Glue web UI, then both flags match in all three places.
steps: Call create_flexible_asset with a real organization_id, flexible_asset_type_id, one trait value, archived=true and restricted=true
Call get_flexible_asset with the returned id and record the response
Open the asset in the IT Glue web UI and compare the Archived and Restricted (MyGlue visibility) flags against the get_flexible_asset response
expect: The IT Glue UI's Archived and Restricted flags match the get_flexible_asset response, and both match the values passed to create_flexible_asset (archived=true, restricted=true).
notes: Needs a real vendor account; no IT Glue test tenant is available to this pipeline. Not a blocker per references/mcp-track.md §3.

text: Given a forced IT Glue error response during create_flexible_asset with a trait value that looks like a credential, when the error is returned, then the error envelope's message text does not contain that trait value, with archived/restricted also passed.
evidence: uv run pytest -q tests/test_flexible_assets.py::test_create_flexible_asset_error_does_not_leak_trait_values (re-run with archived/restricted also passed) -> 1 passed; secret trait value absent from error envelope and caplog
